enemies.name: Lipas Gergasi
enemies.line: A cockroach the size of a motorbike. It flies at your face.

enemies.name: Tikus Mondok
enemies.line: It has eaten through three padlocks today.

enemies.name: Monyet Pencuri
enemies.line: It wants your phone. And your nasi lemak.

enemies.name: Biawak Besar
enemies.line: Slow, heavy, and very sure of itself.

enemies.name: Toyol
enemies.line: Small, green, fast, and after your wallet.

enemies.name: Pocong
enemies.line: It hops. You hear it before you see it.

enemies.name: Hantu Galah
enemies.line: Taller than the lamp posts. Don't look up.

enemies.name: Jerangkung
enemies.line: Bones that rattle in time with the bass.

enemies.name: Orang Minyak
enemies.line: BOSS: slippery, oily, and very hard to hit.

enemies.name: Pontianak
enemies.line: BOSS: you smell frangipani. Then the laughing starts.

enemies.name: Hantu Raya
enemies.line: BOSS: the big one. It looks exactly like you.
